changes.reason: Resource leak evidence fails bundle eligibility and assurance satisfaction without changing runner outcomes. Resource status and leak lists must agree in the runtime validator and published schema.

kubernetes.reason: Runner-neutral evidence validation and in-memory eligibility use no host capabilities, storage adapter or application lifecycle. The same logic consumes evidence produced for any runtime.
constraints: This change consumes recorded leaks; it does not detect new leaks, execute provider operations or certify deployed infrastructure. Explicit not-checked evidence retains its existing meaning.
